scope: Completed seed-42 run and matched seed-42 100-epoch method comparison

metric_policy.macro_task_accuracy: Arithmetic mean of KS, SI, and ER accuracies, weighted equally by task.
metric_policy.accuracy_all: Sample-weighted accuracy across all labelled task examples.
metric_policy.test_usage: Test results are descriptive outcomes of validation-selected checkpoints and were not used to select the method.

post_freeze_assignment_match.interpretation: Assignments and beta remained frozen; this is the agreement of current nearest pairs with frozen pairs.

training_stability.observation: Losses remained finite and validation loss was stable near 0.173-0.176 late in training.

seed42_30_to_100_epoch_comparison.interpretation: A longer budget materially improved the seed-42 soft-sharing result. These are separate runs, although they reproduced the same warm-up assignments and beta distribution.

observations: The opt and best checkpoint are both epoch 99; epoch 100 is slightly worse and should not be reported as the primary result.
Soft sharing is effectively tied with all-row hard sharing on validation macro at seed 42, differing by only 0.0188 percentage points.
The 10% gated method has the highest seed-42 100-epoch validation macro, leading soft sharing by 0.2262 percentage points.
Soft sharing remained numerically stable through 100 epochs and substantially improved over its separate 30-epoch seed-42 run.
The frozen-pair match rate changed only from 88.50% at epoch 30 to 88.05% at epoch 100, so pair agreement did not continue deteriorating materially.
A single 100-epoch seed cannot override the three-seed 30-epoch reliability evidence, particularly because gated hard sharing was unstable for seeds 43 and 44 at 30 epochs.
decision: Experiment 4 is a stable competitive method but is not the seed-42 100-epoch validation winner. Report the epoch-99 opt checkpoint and retain the three-seed 30-epoch analysis when discussing robustness.
